headline: Oil Falls to Its Lowest Level in Three Months
summary: Oil prices fell to their lowest level in three months. Bank of America said geopolitics will remain the main factor determining international oil prices.
why: Brent crude, traded on ICE in London, is the main global benchmark for crude oil prices.
why_moved: Oil dropped to its lowest level in three months, and Bank of America identifies geopolitical developments as the dominant price driver.
original_headline: Petróleo cayó a su nivel más bajo en tres meses
